name: What mistakes cause custom kitchen remodels to go over budget?

mainEntity.name: What mistakes cause custom kitchen remodels to go over budget?
mainEntity.text: What mistakes cause custom kitchen remodels to go over budget?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom kitchen remodels go over budget for a few predictable reasons. Homeowners often finalize design decisions too late, which creates change orders after demolition or after cabinetry has already been ordered. Another common problem is underestimating hidden repairs in older Los Angeles homes, especially plumbing, electrical, framing, and subfloor issues. Budget overruns also happen when allowances are unrealistic, such as choosing premium stone or appliances after a lower-cost estimate was built around midrange products. Scope creep is another major factor, especially when the homeowner adds features like a larger island, custom hood, integrated lighting, or extra storage during the build. The best protection is a detailed proposal, early product selection, and a contingency reserve. It also helps to ask exactly what is included in the price and what is excluded. If a bid is unclear, the project is much more likely to drift beyond budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: The biggest budget mistakes are changing the layout late, choosing appliances too late, underestimating hidden repairs, and approving vague allowances. In custom kitchen work, small selection changes can trigger larger labor and fabrication costs.
